display_long_description:
# Immerse yourself in the gentle art of beekeeping.

Tend your bees, harvest honey, and craft new renovations in your cozy garden. Take a moment to relax, watch the bees forage for nectar, and lose yourself in this wholesome, calming VR beekeeping experience.

[media]

# Harvest your Honey
Slice away the wax to reveal the beautiful honeycomb left below

[media]

# Extracting

Crank the handle and spin your frame to extract the honey

[media]


# Bottle up the honey

One of the best parts of beekeeping. Collect the honey in the jars ready to sell.

[media]

# Sell to locals

Reap the rewards of your hard work and sell the honey to the local townsfolk. Locals request a variety of different honey flavours keeping you on your toes.

[media]

# Renovate the Garden

Craft new renovations to bring your garden to life.

[media]

# Customise Your Apiary

Paint the beehive and flowerbeds to put your own mark on the garden.
